Most of the smart lights in your home are likely smaller bulbs or outlet adapters, but as the market matures, complete lighting product lines that natively connect to Apple Home via the Matter protocol are now beginning to emerge. SwitchBot recently launched the new SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light, featuring extremely high brightness and native Matter support, which can be directly used in your home ceiling fixtures.

HomeKit Weekly is a column focused on smart home accessories, automation tips, and news related to Apple's smart home framework.

Native Matter Support and Apple Home Integration

The most striking selling point of this new ceiling light is its out-of-the-box Matter support, without the need for a SwitchBot Hub. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod remains connected, you can directly access your existing smart home system via a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Hardware Size and Brightness

SwitchBot offers two sizes to meet different needs. The 12-inch model is suitable for hallways and bathrooms, with a brightness of 2000 lumens; the larger 15-inch model is better suited for living rooms and bedrooms, with a brightness of up to 3200 lumens. This ceiling light features built-in stepless dimming from 100% to 0%.

Most smart bulbs typically only allow you to select one color at a time, but this fixture uses RGBIC technology with independent chips, allowing it to display multiple colors simultaneously on the ceiling for dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer traditional lighting, the fixture also has built-in independent warm white and cool white LEDs, with adjustable color temperature from 2700K to 6500K. It also features a power-off memory function, so even during a brief power outage, the fixture will retain its original brightness and color settings. If Thread radio functionality could be added, response speeds within a mesh network should be near-instantaneous. At a price under $50, getting a hardwired, natively Matter-supported light fixture is a very good deal for users looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling lighting.

You can purchase this new SwitchBot RGBICWW on Amazon.
